description: A blue-covered bed with a pale pink pillow fills the scene, and several small white plastic chair-like parts sit near the front edge. The left hand steadies the larger chair base on the bed as a left-hand object, while the right hand lifts a small white rectangular connector above it, lowers and aligns it onto the top post, then presses down and slightly adjusts it side to side to seat it securely as a right-hand object.
